_comment: Version of record for this STL set. Do not edit "version" by hand; run `npx jake bump-set[<set-id>,<version>]`, which writes it here, syncs nuxt-site/server/data/sets.json, and rebuilds the public zip for a free set (at the same URL: the zip's filename carries no version). Editing this file alone leaves the site and the zip disagreeing, and the build scripts refuse to run while the two manifests disagree.
_paidNote: Paid set: never zipped into assets/stls/ (that path is served publicly). Published to R2 by scripts/publish-paid-sets.sh.
